source.check: the eight divisions and names read from the News-Letter's Ulster nominations report (7 May 1936, p. 15), which prints the complete Castlereagh Rural Council list

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the nine electoral divisions. The nominations were received on 6 May 1936 and, as there was no contest, the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Down was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Dundonald's nomination is printed under the Belfast Rural Council heading in the News-Letter list (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
